messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: formula interpretation error
parts:
I'm afraid that it looks like Renjin was not able to compile the C portions of randomForest to Java. It looks like the specific problem is that our compiler does not yet implement BIT_XOR_EXPR :

http://packages.renjin.org/packages/randomForest.html

If you've got some time to play around with I can point you to the part of Renjin that needs to be fixed, but if you're looking for something out of the box I don't think Renjin will meet your needs at this point.

-Alex

Yes that's it exactly: if you add a BIT_XOR_EXPR enum value to GimpleOp and then I think it should be a few lines to add in the switch statement in 

https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/blob/master/tools/gcc-bridge/src/main/java/org/renjin/gcc/translate/AssignmentTranslator.java

I think it might be as simple as :

case BIT_XOR_EXPR:
assignBinaryOp(lhs, "^", operands);
break;

If you can add the offending C source file from RandomForest as a unit test it should be a quick fix.

Best,
Alex
